text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas. Sounds like Hishi Akebono
is going to whip up a feast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her, she must have prepared
a mountain of hearty, magnificent dishes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to splurge a bit on some nice juice, since the chance was there,
I hurried back to the academy under the cold sky――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome baaack.
Dinner's just ready~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the table was not a giant clay pot, but rather
plates beautifully arranged with marinades, omelets, cheeses,
and the like, set facing each other.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Surprised?
This is antipasto, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's an Italian appetizer.
My family runs an Italian restaurant, you see."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why whenever Christmas came around, we always had an Italian-style Christmas feast~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All sorts of dishes are beautifully arranged on plates
and served one course at a time~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's super fun, so I thought
I'd give it a try too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Well then, let's say grace first~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono's Christmas dinner
had officially begun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Up next, we have the primo piatto:
cannelloni~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's pasta~
It was always a Christmas staple back at my family's place~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The cheese might be a bit hot~.
Be careful eating it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Next up is this~. For the secondo piatto,
we have roast chicken~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's today's main dish, after all!
I got so fired up that I started prepping it last night!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And these are the veggies on the side.
They're totally buono when eaten with the meat~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"And here is the last one.
It's Panettone for dolce~♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I heard it's a staple Christmas
dessert in Italy! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I put in tons of dried fruit, so it's
sweet and buono! Let's eat together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a bite of the sliced panettone,
a gentle sweetness spread throughout the mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! Just as buono as always.
It's so sweet and fluffy~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad everything turned out well~
I'm stuffed, fully satisfied♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after finishing our meal, enjoying some fancy juice,
and basking in the afterglow together—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I'm glad it's just the two of us after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, to tell you the truth,
I was actually debating whether to throw a party today or not."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking how fun it'd be to have a lively hot pot together, or
slice up a huge cake and eat until we're totally stuffed~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But you know. It just got me thinking about how
Christmas back home was so relaxing with the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We made today a day to relax with family and make precious memories~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"That's why, you know, I thought it'd be nice
to just spend this year with the two of us, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It really was the right choice after all~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's do this again next year, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Hishi Akebono, I spent a relaxing,
irreplaceable moment.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Next year, and the year after that,
I wanna spend it with you just like this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you also felt that way, Trainer... um...
that would make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. I'm so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, let's hang out again.
Just as I opened my mouth to reply—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I totally forgot~.
We haven't put the star on the tree yet, have we!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It was kind of complicated,
so I was thinking of putting it on later~
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Thank goodness! In that case, I'll leave it to you~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! It's pretty high up, so it must be tough.
Here, I'll lift you up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a cheerful shout, I found myself lifted up into the air by Hishi Akebono once again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Think you can reach it? Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While being firmly supported
by those steady, reassuring arms—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"May I spend next year with her as well."
With that wish in heart, I decorated the star.
